Name: Painted Fish Ponds
Author: jokthefoo
Description:
Have you ever wanted more fish pond colors? Well here you go! Using this mod you can now set any fish pond (fish required) to have any color!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the requirement. (StardewUI)
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use:
[/size]Interact with a fish pond with at least one fish in it to open the standard fish pond menu. If you click the new button it opens a second menu for selecting the color. From there you can either: Set the new color, cancel out, or reset to the default fish pond color.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NtCpGsV.png[/img]

Once you are in this menu you can either input a hexcode for the color, or click on the colored square to open the advanced color menu.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LyHrmSa.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VMiRZgx.png[/img]﻿
